description: Prior notification for changing the use of buildings from agricultural use to storage or distribution (Use Class B8)
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - 2.	During the construction phase, footway and carriageway of the nearby Dick Turpin Way and Great South West Road, which form part of the Transport for London Road Network (TLRN) must remain clear at all times.

Condition : 4 - Any vehicles associated with the construction or day to day running of the development must not park/load/unload on the footway/carriageway of Dick Turpin Way or Great South West Road at any time.

Condition : 5 - 4.	Prior to first use of the buildings for B8 Storage and Distribution use hereby approved, the proposed car and commercial vehicle parking spaces and cycle parking spaces shall be implemented as set out in figure 6 of the planning statement and these will be maintained for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 6 - Notwithstanding the submitted plans, the access road contained within the blue line boundary of the location plan shall be surfaced in a suitable hard bound material. Drainage shall be provided so water does not drain into the Public Highway and the access once provided shall be so maintained at all times.
Condition : 7 - The maximum size vehicle to enter the site shall be 7.5 tonne fixed axle lorry.
